name: colding
description: Send and read email through connected mailboxes. Warm them up, check addresses and run campaigns.

interface.longDescription: Your agent sends and reads email from mailboxes you connect to colding. It can warm them up, check addresses, manage contacts, run campaigns and answer replies. It can also send your app's receipts and sign-in links from a mailbox you keep for that. Each connection belongs to one workspace. The owner chooses its permissions and limits, with Read selected to start, and can revoke it in the console's API keys list. Set up the workspace is an optional permission for mailbox logins, address confirmation, tracking domains and the postal address. It works across the whole workspace and stops working if the key's maker is no longer the owner. With Read too, a key can set up a webhook when none exists or manage one a key saved. A webhook a person saved stays with a person. Agent inboxes and app email from colding's own servers are not available on any plan for sale. Outgoing file attachments and a Python SDK are not available.
capabilities: Read threads and messages from connected mailboxes
Write drafts, reply to messages and organize the inbox
Manage contacts, segments, campaigns and address checks
Send app email through a connected transactional or send-only mailbox
Connect mailboxes by login and manage workspace setup with the owner's permission
Follow delivery events and set up a webhook within the key's permissions
defaultPrompt: List the latest threads in my inbox and summarize the unread ones.
Which mailboxes are connected in my workspace and what is their status?
Show the recent events and alerts in my workspace.
